mapper.select: SELECT B.BNR_SN AS BANNER_ID, B.BNR_NM AS NAME, B.BNR_MAIN_CN AS MAIN_TEXT, B.BNR_SUB_CN AS SUB_TEXT, B.LNKG_URL_ADDR AS LINK_URL, B.LNKG_SE_CD AS LINK_TARGET_CODE, ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = B.PC_ATCH_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS PC_IMAGE_URL, ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = B.MOBL_ATCH_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS MOBILE_IMAGE_URL FROM BANNER_MST B WHERE B.DEL_DT IS NULL AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND ( COALESCE(B.PSTG_PRD_USE_YN, 'N') <> 'Y' OR ( (B.PSTG_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR DATE(B.PSTG_BGNG_YMD) <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (B.PSTG_END_YMD IS NULL OR DATE(B.PSTG_END_YMD) >= CURRENT_DATE) ) ) AND ( COALESCE(B.PC_ATCH_FILE_ID, '') <> '' OR COALESCE(B.MOBL_ATCH_FILE_ID, '') <> '' ) ORDER BY B.SORT_SEQ ASC, B.REG_DT DESC
